grammar.purpose: Link changes without claiming inevitable progress
grammar.explanation: 越练越熟 expresses increasing familiarity with more practice in the stated situation. 越听越不明白 is also possible: more listening can accompany less understanding. The construction links two changing degrees; it is not evidence of causation or a guarantee. Distinguish 越来越熟, which describes one changing state over time.

examples.py: zhè duàn wǒ yuè tīng yuè míng bái .
examples.en: I understand this section more as I listen.

examples.py: shuō de yuè jí , yuè róng yì lòu zì .
examples.en: The more hastily one speaks, the easier it is to omit words.

examples.zh: 没休息的时候，我越练越累。
examples.py: méi xiū xī de shí hou , wǒ yuè liàn yuè lèi .
examples.en: When I have not rested, the more I practise the more tired I get.

commonMistakes.wrong: 越练越熟，所以任何练习都一定有效。
commonMistakes.right: 这次越练越熟，其他练习还要看实际效果。
commonMistakes.why: The grammatical link does not prove a universal learning effect.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + V + 宾语 + V + 补语
grammar.purpose: Keep the object and the performance description
grammar.explanation: 我读这段话读得很慢 repeats 读: the first occurrence carries the object; the second carries the complement. 我学汉语学了两年 gives a duration; 他跑步跑得很快 gives manner. Avoid attaching a long object and a 得 complement to an unrepeated verb as in 我读这段话得很慢. A topic-first alternative exists, but practise the stated repeated-verb pattern here.

examples.py: wǒ dú zhè duàn huà dú de hěn màn .
examples.en: I read this section very slowly.

examples.py: tā xué hàn yǔ xué le liǎng nián .
examples.en: She has studied Chinese for two years.

examples.py: tā xiě zhè gè zì xiě le sān biàn .
examples.en: He wrote this character three times.

commonMistakes.why: Repeat the verb before the complement in this construction.

dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 你今天怎么不放那段录音了？
lines.py: nǐ jīn tiān zěn me bù fàng nà duàn lù yīn le ?
lines.en: Why aren't you playing that recording today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我听了五遍，还是没听清最后那个时间。
lines.py: wǒ tīng le wǔ biàn , hái shi méi tīng qīng zuì hòu nà gè shí jiān .
lines.en: I've listened five times and still can't make out the time at the end.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 前面呢？你觉得他说了什么？
lines.py: qián miàn ne ? nǐ jué de tā shuō le shén me ?
lines.en: What about the beginning? What do you think he said?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 他想周六见面。我读这段话读得很慢，看到最后才发现是下午三点。
lines.py: tā xiǎng zhōu liù jiàn miàn . wǒ dú zhè duàn huà dú de hěn màn , kàn dào zuì hòu cái fā xiàn shì xià wǔ sān diǎn .
lines.en: He wants to meet on Saturday. Reading it slowly, I only noticed at the end that it was three in the afternoon.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我刚才也听成上午了。要不先听最后两句？
lines.py: wǒ gāng cái yě tīng chéng shàng wǔ le . yào bù xiān tīng zuì hòu liǎng jù ?
lines.en: I heard morning too. Shall we start with the last two sentences?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，你先别告诉我答案，让我再试一次。
lines.py: hǎo , nǐ xiān bié gào sù wǒ dá àn , ràng wǒ zài shì yī cì .
lines.en: Sure. Don't tell me the answer yet; let me try again.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这次怎么样？
lines.py: zhè cì zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: How was it this time?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 听出来了！不是越快越好，我刚才太急了。
lines.py: tīng chū lái le ! bù shì yuè kuài yuè hǎo , wǒ gāng cái tài jí le .
lines.en: I got it! Faster isn't always better. I was rushing.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我们休息一下？你杯子里的茶都凉了。
lines.py: nà wǒ men xiū xī yī xià ? nǐ bēi zi lǐ de chá dōu liáng le .
lines.en: Shall we take a break? Your tea's gone cold.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，再听下去，今晚就没完没了了。
lines.py: duì , zài tīng xià qù , jīn wǎn jiù méi wán méi liǎo le .
lines.en: Yes. If we keep listening, we'll be here all night.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Progress that can be recorded
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 上周朋友介绍了一门汉语课程。我试了第一节，老师让我们听两个朋友约时间。
lines.py: shàng zhōu péng you jiè shào le yī mén hàn yǔ kè chéng . wǒ shì le dì yī jié , lǎo shī ràng wǒ men tīng liǎng gè péng you yuē shí jiān .
lines.en: A friend recommended a Chinese course last week. In the first class, we listened to two friends arranging a meeting.

lines.zh: 我基本上听懂了，却把下午三点写成上午三点。朋友看见我的答案，笑着问谁会凌晨去喝茶。
lines.py: wǒ jī běn shàng tīng dǒng le , què bǎ xià wǔ sān diǎn xiě chéng shàng wǔ sān diǎn . péng you kàn jiàn wǒ de dá àn , xiào zhe wèn shéi huì líng chén qù hē chá .
lines.en: I understood most of it but wrote three in the morning instead of the afternoon. My friend laughed and asked who would meet for tea before dawn.

lines.zh: 晚上我又打开教材。我读那几句话读得很慢，把时间圈出来，再听同一段录音。
lines.py: wǎn shang wǒ yòu dǎ kāi jiào cái . wǒ dú nà jǐ jù huà dú de hěn màn , bǎ shí jiān quān chū lái , zài tīng tóng yī duàn lù yīn .
lines.en: That evening I reopened the textbook, read the sentences slowly, circled the time and listened again.

lines.zh: 头两次我还想看字。后来听见下午两个字，就知道这次不能写上午。
lines.py: tóu liǎng cì wǒ hái xiǎng kàn zì . hòu lái tīng jiàn xià wǔ liǎng gè zì , jiù zhī dào zhè cì bù néng xiě shàng wǔ .
lines.en: For the first two tries I still wanted to look at the text. Later, hearing 'afternoon', I knew not to write 'morning'.

lines.zh: 朋友发消息问我明天几点见。我回下午三点，她说这次可别真的半夜来。
lines.py: péng you fā xiāo xī wèn wǒ míng tiān jǐ diǎn jiàn . wǒ huí xià wǔ sān diǎn , tā shuō zhè cì kě bié zhēn de bàn yè lái .
lines.en: My friend asked when to meet tomorrow. I replied three in the afternoon. She told me not to turn up in the middle of the night this time.

lines.zh: 我关了书去洗杯子。今天花的工夫不少，至少明天不会半夜跑去等她。
lines.py: wǒ guān le shū qù xǐ bēi zi . jīn tiān huā de gōng fu bù shǎo , zhì shǎo míng tiān bù huì bàn yè pǎo qù děng tā .
lines.en: I closed the book and washed my cup. It had taken time, but at least I wouldn't go to meet her in the middle of the night tomorrow.

questions.q: What changes in the narrator’s practice?
choices: They slow down and attend to the time
They replace the course with a night job
questions.answer: They slow down and attend to the time

questions.q: What time do the friends arrange for tomorrow?
Why does the friend joke about a night visit?
choices: The narrator previously confused morning and afternoon

lines.en: She has a piano background, so she's learning this piece fairly quickly.

lines.zh: 先把基础练好，再学复杂一点的。
lines.py: xiān bǎ jī chǔ liàn hǎo , zài xué fù zá yī diǎn de .
lines.en: Practise the basics before learning something more complex.

lines.zh: 我们先学几个基本动作。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān xué jǐ gè jī běn dòng zuò .
lines.en: Let's learn a few basic movements first.

lines.zh: 房间里有基本的生活用品。
lines.py: fáng jiān lǐ yǒu jī běn de shēng huó yòng pǐn .
lines.en: The room has basic daily supplies.

lines.zh: 大家基本上都到了，还差两个人。
lines.py: dà jiā jī běn shàng dōu dào le , hái chà liǎng gè rén .
lines.en: Nearly everyone is here; two people are still missing.

lines.zh: 这个房间基本上没变。
lines.py: zhè gè fáng jiān jī běn shàng méi biàn .
lines.en: This room has hardly changed.

lines.zh: 我的听力比以前好一些了。
lines.py: wǒ de tīng lì bǐ yǐ qián hǎo yī xiē le .
lines.en: My listening is a little better than before.

lines.zh: 我们周五有听力考试。
lines.py: wǒ men zhōu wǔ yǒu tīng lì kǎo shì .
lines.en: We have a listening test on Friday.

lines.zh: 老师发给我们一份去年的试题。
lines.py: lǎo shī fā gěi wǒ men yī fèn qù nián de shì tí .
lines.en: The teacher gave us last year's test questions.

lines.zh: 这份试题有二十道题。
lines.py: zhè fèn shì tí yǒu èr shí dào tí .
lines.en: This test has twenty questions.

lines.zh: 这道题目问的是时间，不是地点。
lines.py: zhè dào tí mù wèn de shì shí jiān , bù shì dì diǎn .
lines.en: This question asks for the time, not the place.

lines.zh: 你先读题目，再看下面的图。
lines.py: nǐ xiān dú tí mù , zài kàn xià miàn de tú .
lines.en: Read the question before looking at the picture below.

lines.zh: 初来这里的时候，我谁也不认识。
lines.py: chū lái zhè lǐ de shí hou , wǒ shéi yě bù rèn shi .
lines.en: When I first came here, I didn't know anyone.

lines.zh: 初学的时候，我每天只练十分钟。
lines.py: chū xué de shí hou , wǒ měi tiān zhǐ liàn shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: When I started learning, I practised just ten minutes daily.

lines.zh: 我花了一个下午的工夫整理这些照片。
lines.py: wǒ huā le yī gè xià wǔ de gōng fu zhěng lǐ zhè xiē zhào piān .
lines.en: I spent an afternoon organising these photos.

lines.zh: 做这道菜很费工夫。
lines.py: zuò zhè dào cài hěn fèi gōng fu .
lines.en: This dish takes a lot of time and effort.

lines.zh: 她做菜的功夫是跟妈妈学的。
lines.py: tā zuò cài de gōng fu shì gēn mā mā xué de .
lines.en: She learned her cooking skills from her mum.

lines.zh: 你切菜的功夫比我好多了。
lines.py: nǐ qiè cài de gōng fu bǐ wǒ hǎo duō le .
lines.en: Your knife skills are much better than mine.

lines.zh: 做完功课以后，我们去打球。
lines.py: zuò wán gōng kè yǐ hòu , wǒ men qù dǎ qiú .
lines.en: Let's play ball after finishing our homework.

lines.zh: 她每天晚上帮弟弟做功课。
lines.py: tā měi tiān wǎn shang bāng dì di zuò gōng kè .
lines.en: She helps her younger brother with his homework every evening.

lines.zh: 你帮我推一下，我一个人的力不够。
lines.py: nǐ bāng wǒ tuī yī xià , wǒ yī gè rén de lì bù gòu .
lines.en: Help me push; I'm not strong enough on my own.

lines.zh: 我用了很大的力，门还是推不开。
lines.py: wǒ yòng le hěn dà de lì , mén hái shi tuī bù kāi .
lines.en: I pushed hard, but the door still wouldn't open.

lines.zh: 这支球队很有实力。
lines.py: zhè zhī qiú duì hěn yǒu shí lì .
lines.en: This team is very capable.

lines.zh: 比赛结束以后，大家都看到了她的实力。
lines.py: bǐ sài jié shù yǐ hòu , dà jiā dōu kàn dào le tā de shí lì .
lines.en: Everyone saw her ability after the competition.

lines.zh: 有人一起练，我就更有动力。
lines.py: yǒu rén yì qǐ liàn , wǒ jiù gèng yǒu dòng lì .
lines.en: I feel more motivated when someone practises with me.

lines.zh: 想到周末能见朋友，我就有动力了。
lines.py: xiǎng dào zhōu mò néng jiàn péng you , wǒ jiù yǒu dòng lì le .
lines.en: Thinking of seeing my friends at the weekend motivates me.

lines.zh: 这个理论我还没完全理解。
lines.py: zhè gè lǐ lùn wǒ hái méi wán quán lǐ jiě .
lines.en: I haven't fully understood this theory yet.

lines.zh: 他把这个理论讲得很清楚。
lines.py: tā bǎ zhè gè lǐ lùn jiǎng de hěn qīng chǔ .
lines.en: He explained this theory clearly.

lines.zh: 请计算一下这次一共花了多少钱。
lines.py: qǐng jì suàn yī xià zhè cì yī gòng huā le duō shao qián .
lines.en: Please calculate our total spending this time.

lines.zh: 我用手机计算每个人要付的钱。
lines.py: wǒ yòng shǒu jī jì suàn měi gè rén yào fù de qián .
lines.en: I used my phone to calculate what each person owed.

lines.zh: 他的得分比上次高了十分。
lines.py: tā de dé fēn bǐ shàng cì gāo le shí fēn .
lines.en: His score is ten points higher than last time.

lines.zh: 我们队这场比赛的得分不高。
lines.py: wǒ men duì zhè chǎng bǐ sài de dé fēn bù gāo .
lines.en: Our team's score in this game wasn't high.

lines.zh: 请先输入你的名字。
lines.py: qǐng xiān shū rù nǐ de míng zi .
lines.en: Please enter your name first.

lines.zh: 地址输入错了，我再改一下。
lines.py: dì zhǐ shū rù cuò le , wǒ zài gǎi yī xià .
lines.en: I entered the address incorrectly; I'll fix it.

lines.zh: 他们说起小时候的事，没完没了。
lines.py: tā men shuō qǐ xiǎo shí hòu de shì , méi wán méi liǎo .
lines.en: Once they start on their childhood, they go on endlessly.

lines.zh: 别没完没了地说了，车都快走了。
lines.py: bié méi wán méi liǎo de shuō le , chē dōu kuài zǒu le .
lines.en: Stop going on and on; the bus is about to leave.

lines.zh: 把这两个点连起来，就是一条直线。
lines.py: bǎ zhè liǎng gè diǎn lián qǐ lái , jiù shì yī tiáo zhí xiàn .
lines.en: Join these two points to make a straight line.

lines.zh: 这条线把两个小灯连在一起。
lines.py: zhè tiáo xiàn bǎ liǎng gè xiǎo dēng lián zài yì qǐ .
lines.en: This wire connects the two little lamps.

lines.zh: 头两天先休息，后面再去看朋友。
lines.py: tóu liǎng tiān xiān xiū xī , hòu miàn zài qù kàn péng you .
lines.en: Rest for the first two days, then visit friends.

lines.zh: 头一回见面，她还有点不好意思。
lines.py: tóu yī huí jiàn miàn , tā hái yǒu diǎn bù hǎo yì sī .
lines.en: She was a little shy when we first met.

audio.en: I closed the book and washed my cup. It had taken time, but at least I wouldn't go to meet her in the middle of the night tomorrow.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三42, 三59. Native check: 初 adverb versus the preceding lunar-date prefix lesson, 工夫 versus 功夫 overlap, 了 liǎo in the fixed expression 没完没了, 头 as initial, verb 连 versus other readings, repeated-verb complement naturalness and 越 comparative linkage. No efficacy guarantee or invented score. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三31 / 三78 / 三35 / 三36: 哈哈，笑的是我自己。, 你今天也来参加活动？, 她看起来很累，先问本人。, 照片看上去很亮，不说明现场温度。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Removed grammar-analysis and permission disclaimers from character speech. The scene has one practical problem and a coherent timeline; unrelated vocabulary now has independent examples. Dates, times, causal questions and distractors were checked against their own passage. Every Chinese line still needs native review; particular flags: lamp mechanism 卡/转, 功夫/工夫 register, liǎo in 没完没了, casual travel teasing and the 信 trust sense. No scene claims that emailing constitutes a booking. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
